name: WeatherStationReport
description: Automatic weather station report demonstrating all four phenomenonTimeRelation values. The record carries both an instantaneous observation time (observed_at, role phenomenonTime) for instant and untilNext readings, and an hourly window boundary pair (window_start / window_end, roles phenomenonTimeStart / phenomenonTimeEnd) for interval and accumulation results. The summary window is the half-open period [window_start, window_end); by convention window_end equals observed_at so the instantaneous sample coincides with the window close.

station_id.description: WMO station identifier for the reporting automatic weather station.

observed_at.description: Instant at which the station completed this observation cycle. Serves as the phenomenonTime anchor for instant and untilNext readings.

window_start.description: Start of the preceding hourly summary window. The window is half-open [window_start, window_end): the start instant is included and the end instant is excluded. Used as phenomenonTimeStart for interval and accumulation results.

window_end.description: End of the preceding hourly summary window. By station convention this equals observed_at. Used as phenomenonTimeEnd for interval and accumulation results. The window excludes this instant.

result_time.description: Time at which this report became available for distribution, typically a few seconds after observed_at.

air_pressure.description: Instantaneous station-level barometric pressure. phenomenonTimeRelation instant: the value applies exactly at observed_at; it implies no continuation beyond that single instant.

air_temperature.description: Air temperature at shelter height. phenomenonTimeRelation untilNext: the value applies from observed_at until the next actual compatible observation sharing the same station identifier, procedure, value type, and unit binding. Cadence describes expected recurrence but does not prove that a successor observation exists; without one the support end is unknown.

wind_speed_mean.description: Mean wind speed over the hourly window. phenomenonTimeRelation interval: the value characterizes the half-open phenomenon-time period [window_start, window_end). The statistic summarizes the values in that extent; it does not assert complete coverage or authorize summation with adjacent windows.

precipitation_total.description: Total liquid precipitation accumulated over the hourly window. phenomenonTimeRelation accumulation: the value is the sum of precipitation collected during the half-open period [window_start, window_end). Where phenomenonTimeRelation is accumulation, statistic must be sum.
